about: BATCH 14, ITEM 1 OF THE JOB (his picture of Sun 22 Nov 2026 on Version 552: Review's board about 330 of 375 in the Home Screen app, Play's full width). A second pairs file for the same job, beside the board half's (short-upright-boards-sized-to-height-2026-11-12.json, gates 177 and 178), so this item can be graded without re-running those two long gates. Graded by gate 184 on a trial bundle: Review of the Opera Game at ply 0, 16 and the last, against Play at move 0 on the same launch, in his Home Screen app as it really lays out (a 375x761 layout viewport, the 375x812 shell, env() insets 51/31 reported by Chromium: L.HOME_SCREEN_APP), a 375x812 viewport with the same insets and no shell, the same shape on a 320x568 phone with a 20 inset, and unchanged at 375x761 (ct_safe), 375x667, 320x568 and 812x375 sideways. The real code passes everywhere; three ways the fix could come undone are each caught. NOT COVERED: iOS Safari itself (Chromium's inset override and ct_fullh stand in), text sizes other than 100 percent (gates 177 and 178), the analysis board and the drill Analysis (same fit loop, not read here), his own look on the phone.
